Professional embedded engineer: production-grade AT21CS01/AT21CS11 driver; ESP32-S2/S3, Arduino, PlatformIO. Prioritize deterministic behavior, robust errors, maintainable API, predictable field behavior.

Layout: public headers only in `include/AT21CS/`; implementation `.cpp` in `src/`; examples-only helpers in `common/`. `examples/common/` is not part of the library. Minimal examples: one full single-device CLI and one multi-device CLI. No board-specific pin defaults in library code.

No unbounded loops; every wait has timeout/deadline. No steady-state dynamic allocation. No library logging. No `delay()` in library code except bounded protocol timing/bit windows. Single-wire timed bit protocol, MSb-first; discovery handshake after reset/power-up; preserve ACK/NACK phase granularity in errors; during t_WR, keep SI/O high and use bounded ready polling. AT21CS11 High-Speed only; Standard Speed requests must fail cleanly.

Use explicit state machine in code/docs: `UNINIT`, `PROBING`, `INIT_CONFIG`, `READY`, `BUSY`, `DEGRADED`, `OFFLINE`, `RECOVERING`, `SLEEPING`, `FAULT`. Transitions explicit in lifecycle/recovery. All fallible APIs return `Status`:
const char* msg;
No silent failures. Validation/precondition errors must not be disguised as transport failures.

`Version.h` is Auto-generated (do not edit); generated by `scripts/generate_version.py`. Source of truth: `library.json`. Do not modify technical content in `docs/AT21CS01_AT21CS11_complete_driver_report.md` unless explicitly requested by maintainer. MAJOR: API breaking changes; MINOR: backward-compatible features; PATCH: fixes/docs/refactors.

Naming: members `_camelCase`; methods/functions, locals/params, config fields `camelCase`; constants `CAPS_CASE`.
